name: Modules.Nfc.NdefRecord
description:
**Android**:
The NDEF record is the base type for more type-specific NDEF records. You will generally
work with the type-specific NDEF records (e.g. NdefRecordText, NdefRecordUri, etc.) which have
more applicable properties for each type of record.

Use one of the [Modules.Nfc.createNdefRecordApplication](api:Modules.Nfc#createNdefRecordApplication), [Modules.Nfc.createNdefRecordEmpty](api:Modules.Nfc#createNdefRecordEmpty), 
[Modules.Nfc.createNdefRecordExternal](api:Modules.Nfc#createNdefRecordExternal), [Modules.Nfc.createNdefRecordMedia](api:Modules.Nfc#createNdefRecordMedia), [Modules.Nfc.createNdefRecordSmartPoster](api:Modules.Nfc#createNdefRecordSmartPoster),
[Modules.Nfc.createNdefRecordText](api:Modules.Nfc#createNdefRecordText), [Modules.Nfc.createNdefRecordUnknown](api:Modules.Nfc#createNdefRecordUnknown), or [Modules.Nfc.createNdefRecordUri](api:Modules.Nfc#createNdefRecordUri) method 
variants to create an NDEF record.

**iOS**:
The NFC-functionality is available on iOS 11 and later. It currently only allows
to read specific NDEF-tags - writing tags is not supported by iOS so far.

See also:
[NdefRecord](http://developer.android.com/reference/android/nfc/NdefRecord.html)
